main.title: How a graphics card works, built from scratch
main.description:
Build your own chip and race a CPU in the interactive lesson: https://loathwine.github.io/tricked-rocks/

A screen redraws millions of pixels, sixty times a second. By hand, all of humanity working together couldn't keep up. A graphics card does it without breaking a sweat, using cores that are slower and dumber than your CPU's. In this video we build one from scratch to find out how.

0:00 How much work is one frame?
1:18 One brilliant worker: the CPU
2:17 Hire more workers
2:53 Share one brain: inventing the GPU
3:47 Why AI runs on GPUs
4:25 Why we still need CPUs
4:46 Why GPUs cost as much as a car
5:04 From sand to thinking

Numbers are rounded estimates, chosen to show the scale rather than exact figures.
Narration: AI voice (Gemini TTS). Visuals and sound are generated in code.
